what: Once the section crosses a line 400px in from the screen edge, it plays once. The background fades in over .8s, and the vertical text-line strips (name, tagline, body) appear from .4s at .15s intervals, starting at .1s, unrolling from 1px to full height over .8s like a scroll being opened. .6s later a small button drops in from 30px above over .5s, 1.2s later the image floats up over .6s, and 1.5s later the vertical action button unfolds from 1px to full length over .3s (ease-out)

options.side: Edge to cross — left (right-to-left scroll, default) · right · bottom (vertical page) · top
options.edge: Distance in from the edge (px), default 400
options.lead: When the first band starts to unwind (seconds), default .4
options.unroll: Duration for each band to unwind (s), default .8
options.to: Height after release (px) — to stretch bands to the same length (640) like the original. If empty, each band keeps its own height

note: The band is attached to a box wrapping a vertical-writing (writing-mode: vertical-rl) text line — the height is released from 1px downward, so the band’s background (pattern, color) is supplied by the user. When fully released it fires fx:done.
